name: Iron Man Simulator LEGACY
desc:
The legacy version of IMS.
War Machine is free here!

Press Q to call a suit.
There is a 20 second cooldown after exploding your suit.

Controls:
Q - Call suit
Q/E/R - Repulsors/Chest Repulsor
N - Eject
M - Toggle mask
X - Remove suit
Backspace - Helmet off

Voice commands:
Power on/Power up
Power down/Power off/Cut power/Kill power
Eject
Break
Send suit/Call suit

scripts.features:
Overview of the Menu's Features

Main Tab

This is the central hub for general commands. You can eject all players from the server or specify a player by name to eject them. There's also a "Spam Eject" feature to repeatedly eject a target. The menu also credits its creator, "anonymous#0019," and provides social links for their YouTube and Discord.

Combat Tab

This tab is for aggressive actions and griefing. You can instantly kill a specific player or everyone on the server. There is a kill loop command that continuously kills a target, along with a "Kill Aura" that automatically kills players in a specific radius. You can also explode suits (all or a specific one) and fire a laser at players.

Suits Tab

This section is for directly interacting with the Iron Man suits in the game. You can explode all suits, activate Infinite Power for yourself, enable Godmode (making you invincible), and toggle cooldowns off. There's also a toggle for flight and a button to toggle everyone's mask.

Additionally, under a separate "Suits" tab, there are buttons to call or summon specific Iron Man suits, such as the War Machine, Mark 33, Mark 6, and other versions of the armor.

Parts Tab

This tab allows you to control individual parts of the suit. You can call specific parts like the right hand, left leg, helmet, or torso. There's even a button to call all parts at once.

Commands & Teleports Tabs
These tabs contain administrative and movement commands.

Commands: This section lets you add or remove admins, kick players, and teleport to a player or move to a player, though these are restricted to admins only.

Teleports: This tab has pre-defined teleport locations, allowing you to instantly travel to various places on the map, such as the Avengers Base, Gas Station, Water park, and Secret Base.

This script hub is a very comprehensive and powerful tool, offering a wide range of cheats for combat, administration, and movement within the game. It is clearly designed to give a player a significant advantage, and based on the earlier information you provided, most of these features are likely premium or paid.
